item.title: From Romans to Caliphs — Córdoba The Bridge Between Faiths
item.description: Roman roads, Islamic arches, Christian altars. Córdoba holds them all within itself. Architecture, flamenco, rich cuisine, and centuries of memories fill the corners.

item.title: Among Salt and Stars — Exploring the Atacama Desert
item.description:
Silence. That’s the first thing you notice in the Atacama.
A silence so pure that even the wind with its whispering voice hesitates to break it.
